integrity: The proof is analytic for every integer parameter in the stated range. A finite exact-arithmetic checker is supplementary; originality is qualified by residual historical coverage risk.
scientific_limitations: Only finite, unweighted bicliques with one added intrapart edge, \(m\ge3\) and \(n\ge2\); exact one-edge theorem does not cover other modifications. Independent validation has not occurred.
title: Sharp Hilbert-snowflake exponents after one intrapart edge addition to a biclique
